title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
abstract: arXiv:2610.37819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. translated_title: 面向医学影像的负责任量子机器学习：跨敏感子群体的公平性审计
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中的应用日益受到探索，但其在子群体感知公平性准则下的表现仍缺乏研究。我们对用于医学影像的经典分类器和量子分类器进行了实证公平性审计，并假设量子机器学习并非天生公平。研究评估了两个场景：DDI数据集上的皮肤病变分类（敏感属性：菲茨帕特里克皮肤类型）以及基于CheXpert数据集的胸部X光分类（敏感属性：年龄组）。基于ResNet-18嵌入，我们在基线设置及三种缓解设置下训练了SVM、MLP、QSVM和QCNN，这三种缓解设置为：可微均衡几率（EO）正则化、梯度反转学习（GRL）以及两者结合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）作为外部参照。量子分类器可能获得具有竞争力的总体性能，但仍表现出子群体间的差异。由于较小的子群体AUC差距可能源于最佳群体性能的下降而非整体公平性的提升（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文对经典与量子机器学习分类器在医学影像任务中进行了跨敏感子群体的实证公平性审计，发现量子分类器即使总体性能具有竞争力，仍可能存在子群体差异，并评估了均衡几率正则化、梯度反转学习等多种公平性缓解方法的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging across sensitive subgroups, finding that quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities, and evaluates multiple fairness mitigation methods including Equalized Odds regularization and Gradient Reversal Learning.
